note: Human review of automatic band photos. 'block' removes a wrong photo and stops future lookups for that name. 'pin' sets a reviewed photo: {"artist":"Name","image":"https://...","sourceUrl":"https://...","credit":{"text":"Photo: ...","url":"https://..."}}. Only Deezer artist images, Podiuminfo artist images and Wikimedia Commons files are accepted.
